notes.semetey-1-2013:p0913:b004:l002: Thursday and Friday's Night of Power both retained as printed; primary кадыр entry quotes жуманын Кадыр түнүндө. No calendar harmonization.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0913:b004:l018: Stone tethering places rendered broadly; керме usually a tethering line, but no invented posts, masonry, or knotting procedure supplied.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0913:b004:l025: Primary кысырак young mare not yet foaled; тай yearling. Yearling fillies is qualified reading of compound, not an extra adult-horse count.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0913:b004:l032: Дүрбү spyglass; epic chronology not harmonized or removed.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0913:b006:l007: Көгөргөн stubborn/defiant context, distinguished from preceding literal blue smoke/tent.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0913:b006:l013: Боз кисе gray belt retained; submission around neck is explicitly described, not an invented self-harm action.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0913:b006:l019: Source says sixty although group is conventionally forty companions; no numerical correction made.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0913:b006:l021: Primary бейле- exact бейлеп ук = listen attentively.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0913:b006:l024: Verses24–27 construed as the feared report that Manas's son scattered his iron-strong support. Quotation clarifies implied reported speech, not a new historical action.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0913:b006:l030: Primary өзөк II points to өсөк I, explicitly labels variant өзөк and defines gossip/slander. Exact кыл- construction supports subject of gossip, not body-core imagery.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0914:b003:l016: Primary жазайыл1 weapon/falconet; adjacent мылтык explicitly identifies gun here. Its misfortune sense in other passages is not imposed.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0914:b003:l025: Primary араан I wide-open mouth; broad/wide-mouthed arrow image retained without inventing a particular archaeological arrowhead form.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0914:b003:l033: Primary даңгыт adult male dog or wolf; dogs provisionally chosen in road/scavenging context. Not a Tangut ethnonym. Exact species remains contextual.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0914:b003:l036: Junior-wife sons retained as source's family classification, without assigning an unstated mother.
